Title: Butter-Fried Ribeye Steak
Ingredients: 1 ribeye steak (about 10.5 oz/300 g); 1 tbsp butter; 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Heat a skillet on high heat and melt the butter. Season the ribeye with salt. Sear the steak for 3–4 minutes on each side for medium-rare (cook longer if you prefer it more done). Baste with the melted butter during the last 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let the steak rest for 5 minutes. Slice and serve, adding salt to taste.

Title: Ground Beef Bowl
Ingredients: 1 lb (200 g) ground beef; 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks. Season with salt. Cook for 3–4 minutes until no pink remains. Serve hot in a bowl.

Title: Pan-Seared Duck Breast
Ingredients: 2 duck breasts (6 oz each); 1 tsp salt
Instructions: Score the duck skin in a crosshatch pattern (without cutting the meat). Season both sides with salt. Place duck breast skin-side down in a *cold* skillet, then heat to medium-high heat. Cook for 6 minutes, allowing fat to render. Flip and cook for 4 more minutes. Let rest 5 minutes before slicing.

Title: Beef Marrow Bones
Ingredients: 3 beef marrow bones (about 2 inches long each); 2 tsp salt
Instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Line 3 muffin cups with bacon (around the sides). Crack an egg into each bacon-lined cup. Bake ~20 minutes until the egg is set and bacon is crispy. Transfer beef to a bowl. Let cool 1 minute, then serve.

Title: Tuna Steak with Bone Marrow
Ingredients: 1 tuna steak (5 oz/150 g); bone marrow (in a small pan or microwave)
Instructions: Season tuna steak with salt. Heat a skillet on high. Sear tuna ~1–2 minutes per side for medium-rare. Separately, melt the bone marrow (in a small pan or microwave). Heat tuna steak for 3–4 minutes total. Remove from heat and let the steak rest for 5 minutes. Serve, adding salt to taste.
